evidence.note: Status, issuer, destination and InResponseTo pass. The assertion is encrypted and this tool can't decrypt it, so the audience, recipient, time window, NameID and attribute checks were skipped.

output.fix: Have the IdP sign the Response, or sign the Assertion before encrypting it. The SP can then verify a signature against the pinned IdP certificate before it decrypts. Don't trust any certificate embedded in the message. Then re-run validation on the decrypted assertion to cover the audience, recipient, time window, NameID and attribute checks.

alternatives.why_not: The artifact gives no sign that the SP's decryption failed. The validator simply doesn't support decryption, so it can't tell either way.
